title: Analytical Procedures (Assay/Deg.)[Assay/Purity][Sakura Bloom 20 mg]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Assay/Deg.)[Assay/Purity][Sakura Bloom 20 mg].

action.title: Column
action.description: dC18, 3 µm, 150 X 4.6 mm or equivalent

action.title: Injection volume
action.description: 10 µl each of the test and reference solutions, equivalent to about 5 µg of Sakuramil in the reference solution.

action.title: Tailing factor                    Repeatability
action.description: NMT 2                                      RSD of Sakuramil peak in replicate injections of standard solution should not be more than 0.75 %

action.title: Test solution 1  (for Sakuramil: assay and degradation product)
Identification
action.description: Assess the peak for Sakuramil in the chromatogram of test solution 1 and assess the peak for Sakuramil in the reference solution with respect to retention time. The difference should not exceed ± 2.0 %.

action.title: Assay
action.description: Determine the peak area for Sakuramil in the chromatogram of test solution 1. Also determine the peak area for Sakuramil in the chromatogram of the reference solution.

action.title: Degradation products related to Sakuramil
action.description: Determine the peak area for CP-9-1 and any further unspecified degradation products individually in the chromatogram of test solution 1 and the peak area for Sakuramil in the chromatogram of the reference solution. Disregard any peaks < 0.1 %.

action.title: CP-9-1
action.description: Determine the peak area for CP-9-1 in the chromatogram of test solution 2 and the peak area for Sakuramil in the chromatogram of the reference solution. Disregard any other peaks and CP-9-1 peaks < 0.01 %. Percent content of total degradation products, based on the declared content of Sakuramil. Total all values obtained for the individual degradation products.
